review.official:
Specter, true identity unknown, records missing. Demonstrated extraordinary ability in combating
large creatures
and destroying sturdy targets, speculated to correlate with extensive prior combat experience.
Now stationed as a
Guard
at
Rhodes Island
.

files.description:
Imaging tests done on Specter showed a blurry outline around her internal organs, with visible abnormal dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating signs of Infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 14% 
While Specter showed no physical signs of Originium crystals, her nervous system has suffered a case of severe Infection, the cause behind which remains unknown. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.31u/L 
Still within manageable range. Even then, without knowing the specific cause for her Infection, test data cannot accurately reflect her condition and are of little use. 

In addition, Specter is plagued by severe mental health issues, including but not limited to: memory loss, emotional instability, and lack of self-awareness. Unfortunately, I am not a neurologist nor a psychiatrist and thus unqualified to speculate on the cause or solution, but I wish to make note of her mental condition in her file. 
—Medic Operator Silence

It was difficult probing into Specter's past. When Rhodes Island took her in, she showed temporary lucidity until she lapsed into psychosis before treatment could be administered. 
In her day-to-day life, Specter's mental condition remains unstable, thus greatly limiting her social interactions with other Operators. 
Medical staff will continue administering regular tests and treatment, although success has been limited to date.

Based on intel gathered, Specter was once a nun residing at a convent. The matter was not investigated further due to her current mental state and Rhodes Island's present goals. 
However, Dr. Kal'tsit believes Specter's past is closely linked to that convent, which is also likely hiding the truth behind her mysterious past.

The medical department's in-depth examination revealed Oripathy to be the cause of Specter's deteriorating physical health. 
Furthermore, Specter lacked both the necessary aptitude and knowledge to wield Originium powers. This is puzzling and greatly impacts her combat ability. 
Despite her difficulties, Specter was still devastatingly powerful during her missions, to the point of unsettlement. She undoubtedly has incredible room for growth and improvement. 
Even more important is her polarizing attitudes in combat and in her daily life. 
She is demure and quiet in battle (other than a few occasional mumbles to herself), with a mindless tendency to follow orders to the end, completely unaware of potential danger and obstacles. Her inability to react has endangered her safety more than once. 
It can be concluded that Specter is a vital part of the squad, but a commander must also adapt to her single-mindedness and plan accordingly.

[Classified Log] 
In actuality, when Specter first approached Rhodes Island, she was articulate and sincere, claiming she had just escaped confinement and wished to deliver a message. 
However, she fell silent before she could finish conveying it. In her last moments of sanity, she told the Operator who retrieved her that she has once again gotten entangled in a dark conspiracy. 
After she failed to tear off her habit, she then descended into madness.

Folksong of a Faraway Land: 
When she prayed 
The stars ceased to shimmer 
And when she wept 
The night let out a smile 
And as she lamented 
The anguish sprawled upon her madness 

—From Operator Specter's personal belongings

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Good day. Please allow me a moment of prayer... before I resume my work for the day...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: O benevolent Herald, hear my prayer: please watch over my dreams and ward my soul…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hehehe… Cutting things... cutting things is such fun... Yes, some things were disconnected from the very beginning, their integrity only a false fiction...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ehehehe... Hahahah... AHHAHAHAHAH!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Ehehe…Why were you dodging my sight? So pointless... because I already know exactly what your heart desires...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I have always, always wanted to bring you to a special place... A place where secrets are imparted...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What did you do to me...? Why was I made to drink that strange medicine? Who brought me to this place? PLEASE ANSWER ME!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: That person's words are the complete and utter truth... Dissecting them, dismembering them, disemboweling them... it all grants them salvation...!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You see many things in your dreams that are hard to comprehend?... Those things you see are that soul's despairful tidings... And I, as the messenger, here to convey this exhortation to you... heh…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hearken... Hear the whispers of vast creation's master, echoing from the deep...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Specter, that is what the spirits call me... That kind doctor informed me that I may receive further treatment by helping Rhodes Island... Yes, of course, my powers are yours to command.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Power... is flowing into me...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I have no right to go against your will...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Will this position be a new source of joy for me...? Or... will working for you become my life's joy...?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Good night, my brothers and sisters.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: This will be a path paved with sacrifice.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: All these lost souls on the battlefield... I offer them to you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Humbly awaiting your command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Please let me know the results.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I come from the depth of the ocean…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You are the one who woke me.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Grant joy unto me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Return to the abyss!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I care not for valueless ones.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: There's no escape.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I have conquered all trials you gave me... Were you watching me?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Please guide these lost souls to peaceful enlightenment...!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: None of you shall leave this place!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: They shall pay for this... They must pay…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: May I ask you to assign me to a room where I can see the starry sky?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Heheh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor... What is it inside you… that is driving me to this blissful ecstasy?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Another year has passed? Ahh, how long my years were spent in the sea, so long I cannot even remember how I last spent them... Never we mind. Tell me, Doctor, would you like to be with me by the windowsill today, to watch the stars?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You are... Ah, the Doctor, isn't it?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: How did I spend birthdays before now? Heheh. I don't remember too clearly... While I'm still lucid, Doctor, take this. An illuminous pearl, to be a valuable speck of light to you in the dark of night, there among illusory visions…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Heheheh. I may have seen some vision or other... You should be careful, Doctor. On the route you've chosen, disaster is unavoidable, and it is far more, and far closer, than you ever bargained for. And I—will live in the true field of battle…
